Anya K: Heads up — customer BetaBank pushed for 'strict JSON mode' by default. We need a clear launch acceptance criteria + rollback/runbook before GA. Quick sync?
Samir: +1. Draft acceptance: >=95% schema pass rate on our production prompt corpus, no semantic regressions on top-100 prompts (manual check). Also latency uplift <1% at p99.
Mila P: We can measure that. Two operational questions: what do we do on schema failures by default? hard 4xx errors, best-effort parsing, or soft warn + payload returned?
Tariq R: For hosted GA I lean default -> `warn` with structured metadata: return original output and add `__schema_warnings` array + metric tag `json_mode=soft_fail`. Enterprise customers can opt-in to `enforce`.
DevEx Lead: We should expose a param `validation_mode` in the API: `off|warn|enforce`. Default `warn` for GA. Also per-route and per-customer overrides required.
Samir: Metrics we need: `validation_pass_rate`, `schema_retry_count`, `fallback_rate`, and `schema_failure_rate_by_route`. Gate canary on pass_rate + no notable semantic drift.
Anya K: Launch checklist: docs (SDK examples + migration guide), canary plan (5% -> 20% -> 100%), eval harness run, rollout runbook, and an emergency rollback command. Who volunteers runbook + rollback steps?
Mila P: I'll own the runbook. Draft rollback steps: 1) pause JSON-mode canary, 2) set `validation_mode=warn` globally for route, 3) revert latest model variant if needed, 4) alert customers. CLI examples: `redwood rollout cancel --route chat-prod --feature json_mode` and `redwood route update chat-prod --validation_mode=warn`.
Samir: Need to decide server-side retry behavior on schema mismatch. Option A: automatic single retry with clarifying system prompt: "Ensure output conforms to schema X, only return JSON." Option B: return error to client and let them retry. Option A improves UX, but costs tokens and may hide latent semantic issues.
Tariq R: Proposal: default server-side retry = 0 for `warn`, =1 for `enforce` (unless customer opts out). Retries must be visible in billing and metrics (`schema_retry_tokens`). Also add a `retry_policy` param: `none|auto|manual`.
DevEx Lead: Important to document exact retry prompt used and include opt-out. Also provide sample transformer to run client-side correction so customers can opt to own retries.
Anya K: Acceptance tests: run eval harness with 10k real prompts, measure pass_rate, run semantic equivalence on 200 canary prompts (thresholds TBD). Also smoke test for function-calling interop + embeddings pipelines.
Mila P: For semantic checks we'll use our existing diff-based heuristic + manual spot checks. I'll add a `semantic_regression` label when we see >5% fails on canary.
Samir: Also add behavioral tests: if fallback path returns altered semantics vs earlier baseline, flag as regression.
Tariq R: Security note — ensure schema enforcement doesn't accidentally allow leaking tool outputs. Add security review in checklist.
DevEx Lead: Docs: show migration patterns: 1) start `validation_mode=warn` + opt-in customers to `enforce`, 2) run canary with 5% traffic, 3) monitor metrics over 7 days, 4) promote. Include sample SDK call: ```json
{
  "model": "rwd-10b",
  "mode": "json",
  "validation_mode": "enforce",
  "schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"}}},
  "retry_policy": "auto"
}
```
Anya K: Decision summary so far: default `warn`, per-route override, server-side single retry only for `enforce` by default, per-customer opt-out, canary rollout + metrics gating, runbook owned by Mila. Anything else?
Samir: Add SLA clause for enterprises who require `enforce`: document potential cost and latency impact and offer dedicated capacity option.
Mila P: I'll add the rollback playbook + run the first eval pass tomorrow.
Tariq R: I'll prototype the `__schema_warnings` and `schema_retry_tokens` metrics in telemetry.
DevEx Lead: I'll draft the SDK docs and migration guide.
rollout-bot: Noted — scheduled canary job created for route `chat-prod` at 2027-05-10T15:00Z (5% traffic). Use `/status` to see progress. :rocket:
Anya K: Perfect. We'll reconvene after first canary metrics (48h). Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
